trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: Next year I will have move to Chile.
trap.right: Next year I will move to Chile.
trap.why: Will have + particípio marca conclusão até um momento; para uma decisão ou fato futuro simples usa-se will + base.

mcq.q: Qual indica conclusão até um prazo?
Decisão no momento: “I’m cold.” “I **___** close the window.”

fix.wrong: By December they will have build the bridge.
fix.right: By December they will have built the bridge.

fix.wrong: Next spring she will have start a course.
fix.right: Next spring she will start a course.

fix.wrong: By noon I will has finished.
fix.right: By noon I will have finished.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “They build the bridge by December.” (will have)
rewrite.answer: They will have built the bridge by December.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “She starts a course next spring.” (will)
rewrite.answer: She will start a course next spring.
